text: Port city in the south of France where the story opens.
Morrel’s three-masted merchant ship, returning from Smyrna, Trieste and Naples.
Island off Italy where Napoleon is in exile, and its main port.
The ship’s officer in charge of cargo, trade and accounts. Danglars’s job.
Supporter of Napoleon / supporter of the Bourbon king. In 1815 being thought a Bonapartist is dangerous.
Village of Catalan fishing families just outside Marseille. Home of Mercédès and Fernand.
Waterside tavern where Edmond and Mercédès hold their betrothal feast.
Crown prosecutor. Villefort is the deputy (substitut) in Marseille.
Street in Paris where Noirtier lives. The letter was addressed there.
Fortress prison on a small island in the bay of Marseille.
Dungeon: the underground cells below the ordinary prison rooms.
Bay on the south coast where Napoleon lands, 1 March 1815.
Royalist nickname for Napoleon, who was born on Corsica.
Napoleon’s return to power in 1815, ended by his defeat at Waterloo in June.
Small rocky island off the Tuscan coast, south of Elba. Where Faria says the Spada treasure is hidden.
